title: Acquirer: CSR Ltd; Target: Beerwah Enterprises

body_sections.Summary: CSR Limited/Readymix Holdings Pty Ltd seeks to acquire Beerwah Enterprises.
body_sections.Market definition: Supply of pre-mixed concrete in the Beerwah/Maleny region.
body_sections.Competition analysis: It appears unlikely that the acquisition will result in a substantial lessening of competition considering the small size of the market as well as the competition provided by suppliers in nearby towns such as Caloundra.
